summary: Picks a value or a range by position on a continuous scale, with the formatted value shown at the end of the track.
whenToUse: Approximate values where the position matters more than the exact number: opacity, threshold, zoom.
A range with two thumbs: pass an array of two numbers.
Live previews: update on onValueChange, save on onValueCommitted.
whenNotToUse: An exact number the user knows: use NumberField.
Very large ranges where one step is tiny: pair it with a NumberField or use NumberField alone.

dos.title: Show the value and its unit
dos.text: format makes the value readable: 48%, 4.5, 16 px.

donts.title: A slider for precise input
donts.text: Dragging to exactly 37 is frustrating. Use NumberField when the exact number matters.

accessibility: Base UI Slider: each thumb is a native range input with role slider, aria-valuenow and aria-valuetext from format.
Arrow keys step, Page Up and Page Down or Shift+arrow use largeStep, Home and End jump to min and max.
Range thumbs are named "<label> minimum" and "<label> maximum"; override with thumbLabels.
The filled range uses the signal color (3:1 on the muted track); focus rings the thumb.
contentGuidelines: Label names the quantity: "Minimum contrast", not "Slide to adjust".
Use the hint for what the value affects.
